summary: React hooks connecting product surfaces to Host state and shared frontend behavior.

key_files.useLoroSync.ts: Official-protocol browser replica. Individual node updates reject whole-node downstream immutability before touching local state. Missing parent cleanup is a view projection only; reading nodes cannot commit a parent repair. Rejected updates pause uploads and reconnect. Recovery waits for queued snapshot writes, archives the local document and disables subsequent autosave through unmount before the UI reloads. The fresh mount skips the rejected cache and exposes the saved recovery copy for download. Typed project.load-error messages for this Project pause reconnect without discarding its local draft; explicit retry starts a fresh handshake on the same document. Stale socket events cannot affect the replacement connection. The project-keyed editor owns the document and undo manager; final unmount detaches all sync callbacks, flushes pending edits and releases native handles after effect cleanup. StrictMode effect replay cancels disposal. Snapshot transactions close their database in finally, and recovery captures bytes before asynchronous archive work so navigation can release the replica.
key_files.useNativeGeneratorDraft.ts: Projects native Model and mapped Action Card Generator heads; serializes state and persistent input edits against Host acknowledgements. Copy forks the acknowledged revision and persistent inputs through the existing atomic Generator creation API, preserving source, Action Card identity, and downstream references. Card prompt edits receive the disclosed Definition for input-port validation. Canvas rewiring invalidates a copy request. Idle editors refresh from a newly observed external head; queued work never silently rebases. prepare resolves the installed contract in the same queue before Run pins a revision.
key_files.useHostTimelines.ts: Reads and mutates the Host native Timeline projection with snapshot-bound CAS observations.
key_files.useTextDocumentRevision.ts: Reads the exact plain-text Document revision through the shared Document client. Checks identity and kind, prevents late responses from replacing a newer selection, and exposes loading/errors without a legacy node-content fallback.
